newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin names new foreign trade minister.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin names new foreign trade minister.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin named Mikhail Fradkov on Wednesday to replace Oleg Davydov as Russian minister for foreign trade and economic relations, Russian news agencies quoted the Kremlin as saying.

The agencies said Yeltsin had also named a liberal deputy of the State Duma lower house of parliament, Alexander Pochinok, to head the State Tax Service. Fradkov was formerly deputy foreign trade minister.
The changes virtually complete a far-reaching government reshuffle which gave reformers like Anatoly Chubais and Boris Nemtsov senior jobs in the administration.
Ministers say one of the government's biggest tasks is the need to improve dismal tax revenue and to pay overdue pensions and salaries.
Chubais is due to present amended 1997 spending plans to the Russian parliament on April 23, during a debate on spending and revenues in the first quarter of this year.
Parliament, elected in December 1995, is dominated by communists and other conservatives.
